name: RBX
notes: ⚠ **`confidence` is `low` and the research says why**: it rates this entry medium-low and marks the musical parameters [LOW-CONF], documented only as era and label context with the sound largely inferred from the shared Death Row template. Almost everything below is that inference, and the two things that are not are the two things the research states plainly. The first is the lead figure — "an ominous half-step upper-neighbour figure", which is `halfStepDissonance` at 0.22, nearly four times the parent's, with `phrygian` and `harmonic_minor` weighted up under it. The second is the arrangement problem the lane solves: bass/voice register collision under a booming baritone, "handled by keeping bass below E1 and static". ⚠ **`bassline.register` 21–38 is the compromise on that**: the research's ceiling is E1 (MIDI 28), but `bass.rs` needs 95% distinct lines over a run and a seven-semitone pool cannot produce them, so the span is opened upward to 17 semitones with `followRootsProb` at 0.88 keeping it planted. The documented ceiling is where the weight of the line sits, not where it stops. ⛔ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set: single-chord or two-chord vamps with a sustained string pad and one thin saw lead, note density very low. **The `i–VII` and `i–VI` families are INFERRED** — the research names only "single-chord or two-chord" and not which second chord — so `chordDurationBeats` 3–16 against `syncopated_cell` is what actually carries the harmony's variety. ⚠ The kick is sparse (1 and and-of-3) to leave room for the low vocal, and the hats are weighted 3:1 toward 8ths so this entry does not read as the same kit as the other sparse ones in this band. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 928 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 934/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: octave_echo, bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,4] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 974/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more.
